description:
That time between going under contract and doing your inspection?
It’s not downtime — it’s go-time. ⚡🏠
These next few days can make your transaction smooth ✨ or stressful 😵‍💫.

Here’s what smart buyers 🧠🔍 do before the inspector even shows up:

1️⃣ 𝗚𝗲𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿’𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲 📄
Gives you insight into known issues, repairs, and history. Use it to guide your inspector on what to double-check.

2️⃣ 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝗠𝗠𝗘𝗗𝗜𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗬 📆
Don’t wait! Good inspectors book fast. You need room for follow-ups if red flags pop up.

3️⃣ 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗛𝗢𝗔 𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘀 / 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝗳𝗼 🏘️
Look for rules, fees, restrictions. 🚫 rental limits, 🎨 paint rules, 🚗 parking issues — surprises here = $$ later.

4️⃣ 𝗖𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 ☎️🛡️
Get a quote & confirm no coverage issues (like old roofs or past water damage). If insurance is pricey or unavailable → you need to know ASAP.

5️⃣ 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗯𝘆 𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗱𝗮𝘆 🚗⏰
Neighborhood vibes at 8 AM vs. 10 PM = totally different. Check noise, parking, and the overall feel after the excitement settles.

6️⃣ 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗮 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 📝🔍
Strange smell? Sloping floor? Odd noise? Write everything down so nothing gets missed.

✨ This is your window to investigate, verify, and prepare.
Follow us for expert-level buyer tips 💡🏡—without the overwhelm—so you can shop smart & close with confidence.
